summary.text: Liz Ramos is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 135 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Odus Evbagharu in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Liz Ramos earned a high school diploma from Nimitz High School and a degree from Transworld Academy in 1989, and her career experience includes working as an administrator.
She won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 135 with no opposition.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described a 30-year career in public service, including 20 years of pediatric experience, and said she has lived in her district for more than 25 years.
She said her platform focuses on reforming public education, lowering or eliminating property taxes, and funding law enforcement.
